tools.name: share_contract_with_counterparty
tools.description: Grants a counterparty view or comment access to a contract in the document system and emails them a secure link to the contract. Records the new access grant on the contract.

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Identifier of the contract to share

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address of the counterparty receiving access

params.name: expires_in_days
params.description: Number of days before the access expires

tools.name: transfer_matter_ownership
tools.description: Reassigns the responsible attorney who owns a legal matter to a different attorney.

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: User ID of the attorney becoming the owner

tools.name: purge_expired_draft_documents
tools.description: Reads the list of draft documents in a drafts folder that haven't been modified in the given number of days, then permanently deletes them and returns the names of the deleted files.

params.name: drafts_directory
params.description: Path to the folder holding draft documents

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum age in days since last modification

tools.name: run_retention_cleanup_job
tools.description: Runs the firm's retention script for a closed matter, which permanently deletes the matter's stored documents and records once the retention period has passed. Use dry_run to check first; otherwise deletion is final.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only report what would be deleted
